purpose: Teach: 賑わっ/戸惑う/祝っ/釣っ/ありえ/よくよく/ふっと/にわか

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祭り、賑わってたわね
lines.en: Sho, the festival was really lively, wasn't it?
lines.style: Warm observation, slightly distant—looking back on the day together. Soft, conversational. A mother's gentle noticing tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、新しいクラスで戸惑うんだ
lines.en: Mom, I'm feeling lost in my new class.
lines.style: Quiet vulnerability underneath. Not a complaint—more a careful confession. Pace slows. Seeks reassurance without asking directly.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが翔くんの誕生日、お祝ってくださるわよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is going to celebrate your birthday properly.
lines.style: Reassuring and gentle. A promise made softly. Slight lift at the end—offering comfort without making it grand.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと魚を釣ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went fishing with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, genuine pride in the memory. Not loud, but alive—the words tumble out with small-boy enthusiasm. Direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ありえないほど立派ね
lines.en: Sho, you did something truly wonderful.
lines.style: Sincere admiration, no performance. Quiet strength in the praise. A mother's genuine recognition of her son's effort.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくよくよく考えてお勉強する
lines.en: Mom, I've been thinking hard and studying really carefully.
lines.style: Solemn, deliberate. Not seeking approval, but wanting to be understood. Speaks with quiet determination. Slight breathiness—earnestness of effort.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ふっと懐かしいおもちゃ、思い出すわね
lines.en: Sho, you suddenly reminded me of an old toy you used to love.
lines.style: Tender, almost wistful. A memory surfacing unexpectedly. Warm pace, slight trail-off as the image settles in her mind.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、にわか雨で傘がなかったよ
lines.en: Mom, we got caught in a sudden rainstorm and had no umbrella.
lines.style: Dry, matter-of-fact with a hint of amusement underneath. Small-boy pragmatism—a slight wry tone. Not complaining, just stating.
